comment: Scanned skin (docs/design/scanned-skin.md): the MetaHuman Creator's free scanned skin moved onto the MakeHuman creator bodies. The ScanSkin commandlet writes the meshes, textures and synthesized faces below to game/Saved/ScanSkin; tools/makehuman/scan_skin.py lines each MetaHuman part up with a base body in Blender and bakes its maps onto the base's texture layout (skin_scan*.png beside its FBX), which MakeHumanArt uses for the 4K skin.
